chunks: About the muhrim placing the strap of the water skin upon his head when drawing water, he said: “Yes.”

key_terms.الْقِرْبَةِ: the water skin or water bag
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a muhrim to place the strap of a water skin on his head while drawing water?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person in the state of ihram. It indicates the permissibility of placing the strap of a water skin on the head while drawing water, showing that this specific act does not violate the restrictions of ihram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2642 - Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam (as) about a Muhrim placing the strap of a water bag (qirbah) on his head while drawing water.
